30. 考慮以下數據：
19 10 12 12 13 13 14 15 16 m n
若以上數據的平均值及中位數均為 14 ， 則下列何者正確？
I. m ≥ 14
II. n ≤ 16
III. m + n = 30
A. 只有 I 及 II
B. 只有 I 及 III
C. 只有 II 及 III
D. I 、 II 及 III
reasoning:
1. Average calculation: Sum of given numbers is 10+12+12+13+13+14+15+16+19 = 124. Total 11 numbers including m and n. Mean = (124+m+n)/11 = 14, so 124+m+n = 154, which gives m+n = 30. Statement III is correct. 
2. Median calculation: With 11 numbers, the median is the 6th number when sorted. Sorted known numbers are 10, 12, 12, 13, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19. If median is 14, at least 6 numbers must be ≤ 14 and at least 6 numbers must be ≥ 14. Currently there are 6 numbers ≤ 14 (10, 12, 12, 13, 13, 14) and 4 numbers ≥ 14 (14, 15, 16, 19). For the median to be 14, at least one of m or n must be ≥ 14. Let's assume m ≥ n. Then m must be ≥ 14. Statement I is correct (at least one of them must satisfy this). 
3. Checking II: Since m+n=30, if m=14, then n=16. If m=20, then n=10. Statement II says n ≤ 16, which is generally true if we define m as the larger one, but n can also be larger than 16 (e.g., n=17, m=13). However, if n=17 and m=13, the sorted data is 10, 12, 12, 13, 13, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 19. Here the 6th number is 13, so median is 13, not 14. To keep the median 14, at least two numbers from {m, n, 14, 15, 16, 19} must be 14 or less while keeping 6 values ≥ 14. Actually, for median=14, at least 6 values must be ≥ 14. We have {14, 15, 16, 19}, so we need 2 more from {m, n}. Thus both m and n must be ≥ 14. If both m, n ≥ 14 and m + n = 30, then the possible values are (14, 16) or (15, 15). In either case, m ≥ 14 and n ≤ 16 are both true. Wait, if m=14, n=16, then both I and II are satisfied. If m=15, n=15, both are satisfied. Thus I, II, and III are correct.
